description: How Nigerian pension assets were invested, month by month: value (naira) and share of total assets. Without asset_class, the total and the seven asset groups. With it, that one line (a group such as "Equities", or a class such as "treasury_bills" or "Nigerian equities"). Figures held for review are absent, not estimated.

asset_class.description: Optional group, class id or label.

period_end.description: Last month, e.g. 2026-08. Default: the latest.
